characters.name: Hanen (the Rooster)
characters.prompt: A proud Norwegian farm rooster with vibrant red comb, bright plumage, and a confident stance; depicted in a rustic farm setting from 1400–1850 Norway, wearing a small decorative ribbon around its neck in the style of old Norwegian folk tradition.

characters.name: Gjøgen (the Cuckoo)
characters.prompt: A slender cuckoo bird perched on a simple wooden fence post in rural Norway, 1400–1850. Its feathers are soft grayish-brown with subtle stripes, and it has an inquisitive gaze, reflecting its cunning and persistent nature.

characters.name: Aarhanen (the Year-Rooster)
characters.prompt: A slightly older, wise-looking rooster with regal posture, distinguished by a streak of silver in its feathers, set against a Norwegian farm backdrop from the 1400–1850 era. It appears calm and thoughtful, symbolizing fairness and reason.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: Illustrate a Norwegian farmyard from the 1400–1850 period, showing the three birds—Hanen, Gjøgen, and Aarhanen—around a single cow. Emphasize the rustic wooden barn, rolling green hills, and traditional Norwegian attire where appropriate. Each bird should exhibit unique expressions as they argue over who owns the cow.
modernMainImagePrompt: Depict a bustling contemporary Norwegian farm scene with modern barns, farming equipment, and the three birds—now stylized to fit current day aesthetics—negotiating over a cow in a modern setting, perhaps surrounded by paved paths, fences, and updated detail that reflects today's society.
childMainImagePrompt: Show a bright, playful cartoon farm with smiling animals and friendly scenery. Hanen, Gjøgen, and Aarhanen appear as adorable, cheerful birds arguing in a gentle, kid-friendly way over a cuddly cow. Keep the colors soft and inviting for a young audience, around 5 years old.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: Vis en norsk gård i dag med grønne åkre og en enkel låve. Hanen, Gjøgen og Århanen står ved kua og diskuterer hvem som eier den. Tydelige figurer i et vennlig landskap gjør historien lett å forstå med moderne norsk språk.
englishMainImagePrompt: Portray an old Norwegian countryside scene with three distinct birds—a red-combed rooster (Hanen), a slender grayish cuckoo (Gjøgen), and a dignified year-rooster (Aarhanen)—gathered around a single cow. Emphasize the 1400–1850 rural setting, showcasing their debate over who should own the cow, capturing the folktale’s spirit and style in an English narrative.
